task: Safe navigation when selecting another ledger
behavior: Selecting a different accessible ledger returns to /projects and replaces the current history entry.
Old project IDs, query parameters and fragments are cleared before the selected ledger renders.
A lost selected membership also leaves an old project detail route before falling back to another ledger.
Selecting the same ledger preserves the current page and draft; notification targets remain explicit.
Old reads are aborted and late responses do not restore prior ledger data or drafts.
